title: Light Jamaican Chicken Curry
description: A buttery and fluffy Jamaican dish featuring single cream and soffritto-base, perfect for a hangover cure, served in a lotus-leaf-wrap. This dish is a unique and delicious twist on traditional Jamaican cuisine.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add 2 tablespoons of oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the single cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10 minutes.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Wrap the curry in lotus leaves and serve hot.
